title: Time and Space: A Dual-Axis, Evidence-Grounded Context Substrate for Personal Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.16492v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We argue that a binding constraint for personal agents is not model capacity but the form in which context is represented: the agent does not know which entity a phrase denotes, when a fact held, or which source record licenses a claim. We call the missing representation spatio-temporal context (STC) and define it on two axes. The temporal axis carries event time, validity intervals and ingestion time. The spatial axis is a relational space in which entities are points, typed relations are edges, and distance is semantic rather than geographic; physical places are one entity type among many. Every relation is anchored to immutable source records, and every answer must be closed over those records. We formalise the substrate and six invariants, a context operator that composes temporal intersection with relational expansion, an ambiguity-preserving resolution state machine, a conflict detector that converts mutually exclusive facts into u

translated_title: 时间与空间：面向个人智能体的双轴、证据锚定的上下文基底
translated_abstract: 我们认为，个人智能体的关键约束并不在于模型容量，而在于上下文被表示的形式：智能体不知道某个短语指代哪个实体、某个事实在何时成立、或者哪条源记录为某个论断提供依据。我们将这种缺失的表示称为时空上下文（STC），并在两个轴上对其进行定义。时间轴承载事件时间、有效区间和摄取时间。空间轴则是一个关系空间：实体是其中的点，类型化关系是边，距离是语义意义上的而非地理意义上的；物理地点只是众多实体类型中的一种。每条关系都锚定于不可变的源记录，且每个答案都必须在这些记录上闭合。我们对该基底及六条不变式进行了形式化，提出了一个将时间求交与关系扩展组合而成的上下文算子、一个保留歧义的消解状态机，以及一个将互斥事实转化为……的冲突检测器（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出面向个人智能体的“时空上下文（STC）”双轴表示框架——时间轴承载事件时间与有效区间、空间轴为语义实体关系图，所有关系锚定于不可变源记录并辅以六条不变式、上下文算子、歧义保留消解状态机与冲突检测器，使智能体的回答可追溯至证据并解决实体指代、时间有效性与来源授权问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes a dual-axis, evidence-grounded spatio-temporal context (STC) substrate for personal agents—where a temporal axis carries event times and validity intervals and a spatial axis encodes semantic entity-relations—anchoring every relation to immutable source records with six invariants, a context operator, an ambiguity-preserving resolution state machine, and a conflict detector to make agent answers traceable and grounded in evidence.
